, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: They conflated the non-recipient with the non-giver. By matching the 11 gifts to interests, they identified Rebecca as the only person whose interests weren’t represented—meaning she did not receive a gift. They then mislabeled this as “Non-giver.” Without gift assignment data, the actual person who failed to give a gift cannot be determined from the document.
